issue.title: Use-after-free in `_io.BytesIO.writelines` via re-entrant `__buffer__` close

labels.name: extension-modules
labels.description: C modules in the Modules dir

labels.name: type-crash
labels.description: A hard crash of the interpreter, possibly with a core dump

comments.body:
PyObject_GetBuffer() can execute user code (e.g. via `__buffer__`), which may close or otherwise mutate a BytesIO object while write() or writelines() is in progress. This could invalidate the internal buffer and lead to a use-after-free.

I've proposed a PR here: https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/143408. Temporarily bump the exports counter while acquiring the input buffer to block re-entrant mutation, and add regression tests to ensure such cases raise BufferError instead of crashing.
